name: Nishikujou Kanon
source: A famous up-and-coming pianist whose parents are also musicians. She has won many competitions, and people expect a lot from her. Also [url=/c40828]Shuuji's[/url] underclassman, she is always practicing in the music room. Her first encounter with Shuuji occurs when she overhears him saying that her piano performance lacks “emotion”.
